loc_determination_steps.rationale: No subdimension requires Level 4 or Level 4 Psychiatric care

D2 Physical Health requires minimum Level 1.7 (medically managed). D4 Substance Use Risks requires minimum Level 2.5 (Level 2 need). Medically managed + Level 2 = Level 2.7. COE indicated by D3 Active Psychiatric Symptoms (2A). Recovery Residence indicated by D5 Safety (A).

recommended_level_name: Medically Monitored Intensive Outpatient, Co-occurring Enhanced + Recovery Residence
level_rationale: Algorithmically determined after QA corrections: Requires medically managed care AND Level 2 services. (changed from 2.7 COE)
dimension_6_notes: Patient demonstrates good engagement and willingness to participate. Denver plan with brother represents patient's preferred and most viable option. No apparent barriers to accepting recommended level.
clinical_summary: 37-year-old female with severe polysubstance use disorder, PTSD, and Major Depression, stabilized after overdose and polysubstance withdrawal. Currently has untreated Hepatitis C with liver disease, nutritional concerns, and chronic passive suicidal ideation. Patient shows strong treatment engagement and insight into relapse triggers. Current environment is unsafe due to intimate partner violence. Denver relocation plan with supportive brother provides recovery-oriented environment.
